text: We now have three clusters, and none of the remaining positive-affinity merges is legal. The algorithm stops even though target K is two. This target is fundamentally infeasible: two clusters of capacity two hold only four units. Our graph contains five units, so no algorithm can satisfy both requirements. The result respects capacity, but target reached must be reported as false.

cues.zh: 这个目标本身不可行：两个容量为二的簇最多容纳四个大小单位。

cues.en: Our graph contains five units, so no algorithm can satisfy both requirements.
cues.zh: 图中共有五个大小单位，因此任何算法都无法同时满足这两个要求。

cues.en: The result respects capacity, but target reached must be reported as false.
cues.zh: 结果符合容量约束，但“是否达到目标”必须报告为否。
